# Definitions

**Abbreviations:** DLPFC = dorsolateral prefrontal cortex, FC = frontal cortex, CN = head of caudate nucleus, PCC = posterior cingulate cortex, TC = temporal cortex

**AD diagnosis:** Braak stage ≥ IV and CERAD measure equal to moderate/probable AD or frequent/definite AD.

**Control diagnosis:** Braak stage ≤ III and CERAD measure equal to none/no AD or sparse/possible AD.

Any donors who did not fall under these criteria were assigned as “other”.

**Pre-cleaning:** filtered RIN\>2.5; 18 batch/plate combinations report (final_batch 1_9 (n=1) was merged with 1_6)

# Starting dataset

**n=`r nrow(md_all)` samples, before filtering and quality checks**

**n=`r nrow(pheno)` samples, after filtering for RIN > 2.5 (removal of 191 samples)**

# RIN

**Samples were marked as QC failures if RIN was NA (n=`r nrow(md_all_RIN_na)`)**

**Samples were excluded if RIN \< 2.5**

RIN is a numerical value that indicates RNA integrity. Two different library preps were used for ROSMAP Data, polyA and rRNA depletion. The RIN score is calculated based on the presence of rRNA, so for samples that have undergone rRNA depletion the RIN score is a less reliable source of RNA quality. It is flagged here but will not be used as exclusion criteria. Rather, we used PCA scores greater than four standard deviations from the mean, as shown below.

```{r generate-RIN-plots2, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
md_all_RIN_na <- md_all[is.na(md_all$RIN),] 
md_all_RIN_WARN <- md_all[(is.na(md_all$RIN) | md_all$RIN < 2.5),] 

plt1 <- ggplot(md_all[!is.na(md_all$RIN),] , aes(x = tissue2, y = RIN, fill = tissue2)) +
  geom_boxplot(outliers = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE, width = 0.5) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color=RIN<2.5), size = 0.5, na.rm = TRUE, width = 0.3) +
  scale_color_manual(values=c("TRUE" = "red", "FALSE" = "black")) +
  xlab(NULL) +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_fill_viridis(discrete = TRUE, begin = 0.1, end = 0.9, alpha = 0.7) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        title = element_text(face = "bold")) +
  labs(color = "RIN < 2.5", fill = "Tissue")

print(plt1)
```

# Inferred sex

Examine average expression of key Y-chromosome genes to infer the sex of each sample. Genes used are _RPS4Y1_, _EIF1AY_, _DDX3Y_, and _KDM5D_, which were determined to be robust markers for sex in Staedtler, et al (2013). Plots also used _XIST_ as a markers for females.

Samples whose inferred sex did not match their reported sex were marked as QC failures (for now).

```{r generate-sex prediction-plots1, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
## Generate sex prediction plots
sc_data <- counts_sex_ck
tissue <- "all"
md_all <- pheno

rownames(sc_data) <- sc_data$gene_id
samples_sex <- intersect(md_all$specimenID, colnames(sc_data))
sc_data    <- sc_data[, samples_sex, drop = FALSE]
md_all <- md_all[md_all$specimenID %in% samples_sex, ]

# gene expression reads file
sc_data$gene_id <- rownames(sc_data)
sc_data$gene_id <- sub("\\..*$", "", sc_data$gene_id)
sc_data2 <- sc_data[!duplicated(sc_data$gene_id),]
sc_data2 <- as.data.frame(sc_data2)
rownames(sc_data2) <- sc_data2$gene_id
sc_data2 <- sc_data2 %>% dplyr::select(-gene_id)

#specID_tissue <- md_all$specimenID[md_all$tissue2 == tissue2_var]
#sc_data2 <- sc_data2[,colnames(sc_data2) %in% specID_tissue]

# md file with self reported sex
md_all_sorted <- md_all [match(colnames(sc_data2), md_all$specimenID), ]
reported_sex_vector <- md_all_sorted$sex

# Vector of names
names <- colnames(sc_data2)

# Assign names
names(reported_sex_vector) <- names

expr_mat <- sc_data2

# run code 
result <- predict_sex(expr_mat, reported = reported_sex_vector, threshold = 0)
result_md <- merge(result, md_all, by.x="sample", by.y="specimenID", all=T)
result_md_filtered <- result_md  %>% group_by(individualID) %>%
  filter(any(concordant == FALSE)) %>% ungroup()

result2 <- result %>%
  left_join(md_all_sorted %>% dplyr::select(specimenID, tissue, individualID), by = c("sample" = "specimenID"))

#attr(sc_data2, "threshold") <- list(xist = 2^10, y = 2^6)
#attr(sc_data2, "threshold") <- list(xist = 2^10)
attr(sc_data2, "threshold") <- list(y = 2^6)
thr <- attr(sc_data2, "threshold")
  
result2 <- result2 |> mutate(concordant2 = case_when(
     # (xist_score > thr$xist) & (y_score > thr$y) ~ "Flagged",
 #      (xist_score > thr$xist) ~ "Flagged",
      !concordant                                  ~ "Discordant",
      TRUE                                         ~ "Concordant" ))

QC_failures_sex <- result2 %>% filter(concordant2 == "Discordant" | concordant2 == "Flagged" )
QC_nonfailures_sex <- result2 %>% filter(concordant2 == "Concordant" )

meta_sub_sex_unique <- result2 %>% filter(concordant2 == "Discordant" | concordant2 == "Flagged" ) %>% distinct(individualID, .keep_all = TRUE)
```

**Reported sex vs inferred sex mismatches: `r nrow(QC_failures_sex)` sample(s) from `r nrow(meta_sub_sex_unique)` individuals across all brain tissue regions (n=`r ncol(sc_data2)` total samples).**

# Validation for FastQC

Examine Phred score and average base content at each position of a read.

Samples fail QC if the Phred score is \< 20.

Samples get a QC warning if the Phred score is below Q1 - 1.5 \* IQR.

Samples get a QC warning if the base content is above Q3 + 1.5 \* IQR for any base.

Samples with 2 or more warnings across all QC metrics fail QC.

```{r fast-qc validation, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# Load fastqc stats (ROSMAP_fq_stats.rds)
invisible(synLogin(silent=TRUE))
file_entity2 <- synGet("syn76283403") #.rds "basic_stats", "phred_per_base", "base_content"
load(file_entity2$path)
basic_stats <- my_bundle$basic_stats
phred_per_base <- my_bundle$phred_per_base
base_content <- my_bundle$base_content

md_all <- pheno

# Load gene metadata
syn_gene_file <- synapser::synGet('syn74907403')
gene_info <- read.csv(syn_gene_file$path)

# CLEANUP 
# removing X from specimenIDs
basic_stats$specimenID <- gsub("^X", "", basic_stats$specimenID)
base_content$specimenID <- gsub("^X", "", base_content$specimenID)
phred_per_base$specimenID <- gsub("^X", "", phred_per_base$specimenID)

# specimenID format varied between the two datasets because of periods and dashes
# basic_stats
#nrow(basic_stats)
test_before1 <- md_all[!(md_all$specimenID %in% basic_stats$specimenID),]
basic_stats$specimenID <- sub("_[^_]*$", "", basic_stats$specimenID)
basic_stats$specimenID <- sub("_[^_]*$", "", basic_stats$specimenID)
basic_stats$specimenID <- gsub(".", "-",basic_stats$specimenID, fixed = TRUE)
test_after1a <- md_all[!(md_all$specimenID %in% basic_stats$specimenID),]
test_after1b <- md_all[(md_all$specimenID %in% basic_stats$specimenID),]

# base_content
test_before2 <- md_all[!(md_all$specimenID %in% base_content$specimenID),]
base_content$specimenID <- sub("_[^_]*$", "", base_content$specimenID)
base_content$specimenID <- sub("_[^_]*$", "", base_content$specimenID)
base_content$specimenID <- gsub(".", "-",base_content$specimenID, fixed = TRUE)
test_after2 <- md_all[!(md_all$specimenID %in% base_content$specimenID),]
test_after2 <- md_all[(md_all$specimenID %in% base_content$specimenID),]

# phred_per_base
test_before3 <- md_all[!(md_all$specimenID %in% phred_per_base$specimenID),]
phred_per_base$specimenID <- sub("_[^_]*$", "", phred_per_base$specimenID)
phred_per_base$specimenID <- sub("_[^_]*$", "", phred_per_base$specimenID)
phred_per_base$specimenID <- gsub(".", "-",phred_per_base$specimenID, fixed = TRUE)
test_after3 <- md_all[!(md_all$specimenID %in% phred_per_base$specimenID),]
test_after3 <- md_all[(md_all$specimenID %in% phred_per_base$specimenID),]

base_content2 <- merge(base_content, md_all, by="specimenID")
basic_stats2 <- merge(basic_stats, md_all, by="specimenID")
phred_per_base2 <- merge(phred_per_base, md_all, by="specimenID")

base_content2 <- base_content2 %>% mutate(read = paste0("R", str_sub(sample, -1)))
basic_stats2  <- basic_stats2 %>% mutate(read = paste0("R", str_sub(sample, -1)))
phred_per_base2 <- phred_per_base2 %>% mutate(read = paste0("R", str_sub(sample, -1)))


# validate-fastqc 
thresholds <- NULL
thresholds$phred <- 20

base_content2 <- base_content2 |>
  group_by(read, tissue2, base) |>
  mutate(outlier_color = ifelse(is_outlier_IQR(mean_base_deviation),
                                "black", NA)) |>
  ungroup()

plt1b <- ggplot(base_content2,
               aes(x = base, y = mean_base_deviation, fill = base)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = outlier_color), # <-- Map inside aes() without using $
              size = 0.5, width = 0.05, na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_color_identity() +                # <-- Tells ggplot to use the actual color strings
  theme_bw() +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(read), cols = vars(tissue2)) +
  scale_fill_viridis(discrete = TRUE, begin = 0.1, alpha = 0.8) +
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#EEEEEE", color = "black"),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
        title = element_text(face = "bold")) +
  ggtitle("Mean deviation from expected base proportions")

print(plt1b)

# Using the mean content deviation from 25% of each base at each position.
# Mayo uses sum of deviation instead of mean, but they're equivalent for the
# purposes of outlier finding. Unlike for the graph, we only want outliers that
# are on the upper tail (over-representation of a base).
base_content_outliers <- base_content2 |>
  dplyr::group_by(tissue, read, base) |>
  mutate(is_outlier = is_outlier_IQR(mean_base_deviation, tail = "upper")) |>
  subset(is_outlier == TRUE) |>
  pull(specimenID)

# Any base falling below the Phred threshold marks the sample as failing QC
phred_fail <- phred_per_base |>
  subset(Median < thresholds$phred) |>
  pull(specimenID)

phred_outliers <- phred_per_base |>
  group_by(position) |>
  mutate(is_outlier = is_outlier_IQR(Median, tail = "lower")) |>
  subset(is_outlier == TRUE) |>
  pull(specimenID)

metadata <- md_all
metadata$base_content_warn <- metadata$specimenID %in% base_content_outliers
metadata$phred_score_valid <- !(metadata$specimenID %in% phred_fail)
metadata$phred_score_warn <- metadata$specimenID %in% phred_outliers

n_fqc_warn_fail <- sum(metadata$base_content_warn | metadata$phred_score_warn |
                         !metadata$phred_score_valid)


# ---- print_fastqc-results
meta_sub_fastqc <- subset(metadata, base_content_warn | phred_score_warn | !phred_score_valid) |>
  dplyr::select(specimenID, tissue, base_content_warn, phred_score_warn, phred_score_valid) |>
  dplyr:: mutate(
    `Phred Score` = case_when(
      !phred_score_valid ~ "FAIL",
      phred_score_warn ~ "WARN",
      .default = "."
    ),
    `Base Content` = ifelse(base_content_warn == TRUE, "WARN", ".")
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(specimenID, tissue, `Phred Score`, `Base Content`) |>
  dplyr::rename(Tissue = tissue, `Specimen ID` = specimenID) |>
  arrange(Tissue, `Specimen ID`)

#cat("This table shows Phred QC warnings vs Base Content QC warnings -- FAIL if QC warning for both?")
#print(table(meta_sub_fastqc$`Phred Score`, meta_sub_fastqc$`Base Content`))
```

**FastQC Phred failure(s):** `r sum(!metadata$phred_score_valid)` sample(s)

**FastQC Phred warning(s):** `r sum(metadata$phred_score_warn)` sample(s)

**FastQC base content warning(s):** `r sum(metadata$base_content_warn)` sample(s)

# Validation for MultiQC

Examined percentage of reads mapped and percentage of reads duplicated.

Samples were marked as QC failure if \< 70% reads mapped or \> 80% duplicated reads.

Samples were flagged as QC warning if reads mapped reported less than Q1 - 1.5 \* IQR or duplicate reads reported more than Q3 + 3 \* IQR. QC warnings were evaluated independently for each brain region (tissue type).

```{r multi-qc validation, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

#                                     tail = "upper", IQR_mult = 3)) |>
#  subset(is_outlier == TRUE) |>
#  pull(specimenID)

reads_align_outliers <- purrr::map(tissue_var, \(t) {
   md_all |>
    filter(tissue == t) |>
    mutate(is_outlier = is_outlier_IQR(rsem_alignable_percent,
                                       tail = "upper", IQR_mult = 3)) |>
    filter(is_outlier == TRUE) |>
    pull(specimenID)
}) |>
  unlist()

md_all$reads_mapped_fail <- md_all$specimenID %in% reads_mapped_fail
md_all$reads_mapped_warn <- md_all$specimenID %in% reads_mapped_outliers
md_all$reads_mapped_valid <- !(md_all$specimenID %in% reads_mapped_fail)

md_all$reads_duplicated_fail <- md_all$specimenID %in% reads_dupe_fail
md_all$reads_duplicated_warn <- md_all$specimenID %in% reads_dupe_outliers
md_all$reads_duplicated_valid <- !(md_all$specimenID %in% reads_dupe_fail)

md_all$reads_align_fail  <- md_all$specimenID %in% reads_align_fail 
md_all$reads_align_warn <- md_all$specimenID %in% reads_align_outliers
md_all$reads_align_valid <- !(md_all$specimenID %in% reads_align_fail)

mqc_plot <-  md_all |>
  mutate(
    mapped_status = case_when(
      specimenID %in% reads_mapped_fail ~ "Fail",
      specimenID %in% reads_mapped_outliers & !specimenID %in% reads_mapped_fail ~ "Warn",
      .default = "Pass"
    ),
    duplicated_status = case_when(
      specimenID %in% reads_dupe_fail ~ "Fail",
      specimenID %in% reads_dupe_outliers & !specimenID %in% reads_dupe_fail ~ "Warn",
      .default = "Pass"
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(mapped_status = factor(mapped_status, levels = c("Fail", "Warn", "Pass")))
```

# CQN normalization

Final cqn outputs uploaded to synapse: "ROSMAP_md_counts_cqn_DLPFC_CN_PCC_FC_TC.rds", parent = "syn75192265"


**Library preparation bias:** Library preparation method is a systematic technical covariate that affects GC content and gene length biases because these curves are not constant across library prep methods.

*Solution:* Independent CQN models were fit within each library prep group (batch 2 and batch 3 and batch 4 separated within rRNA depletion group, and batch_final 2_9 separated within polyA group), the resulting offset matrices was merged back together

*NOTE*: Due to small numbers, batch 2_1 and 2_2 were combined with 2_3, batch 1_0 was combined with 1_1, and batch 3_4 was combined with 3_3




```{r cqn, fig.width=12, fig.height=16, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
invisible(synLogin(silent=TRUE))
file_entity <- synGet("syn76425058") # ROSMAP_qc.rds "metadata" and "counts" for DLPFC CN PCC TC FC
invisible(list2env(readRDS(file_entity$path), envir = .GlobalEnv))

#dim(counts)
md <- metadata
#table(md$final_batch)
md$final_batch[md$final_batch %in% c("2_1", "2_2")] <- "2_3"
md$final_batch[md$final_batch %in% c("1_0")] <- "1_1"
md$final_batch[md$final_batch %in% c("3_4")] <- "3_3"
#table(md$final_batch)
md$final_batch <- droplevels(md$final_batch)
#table(md$final_batch)

library(cqn)
#table(md$libraryPrep)
md$libraryPrep2[md$libraryPrep=="polyAselection"] <- "polyAselection"
md$libraryPrep2[md$libraryPrep=="rRNAdepletion" & md$procbatch== 2] <- "rRNAdepletion_b2"
md$libraryPrep2[md$libraryPrep=="rRNAdepletion" & md$procbatch== 3] <- "rRNAdepletion_b3"
md$libraryPrep2[md$libraryPrep=="rRNAdepletion" & md$procbatch== 4] <- "rRNAdepletion_b4"
#table(md$libraryPrep2)

md$libraryPrep3[md$libraryPrep=="polyAselection"] <- "polyAselection"
md$libraryPrep3[md$libraryPrep=="rRNAdepletion" & md$procbatch== 2] <- "rRNAdepletion_b2"
md$libraryPrep3[md$libraryPrep=="rRNAdepletion" & md$procbatch== 3] <- "rRNAdepletion_b3"
md$libraryPrep3[md$libraryPrep=="rRNAdepletion" & md$procbatch== 4] <- "rRNAdepletion_b4"
md$libraryPrep3[md$final_batch == "2_9"] <- "2_9"
#table(md$libraryPrep3)

# Split samples by library prep
#prep_groups <- split(seq_len(ncol(counts)), md$libraryPrep2)
prep_groups <- split(seq_len(ncol(counts)), md$libraryPrep3)

cqn_offsets <- matrix(NA, nrow=nrow(counts), ncol=ncol(counts))
cqn_E <- matrix(NA, nrow=nrow(counts), ncol=ncol(counts))

# Align samples 
syn_gene_file <- synapser::synGet('syn74907403')
gene_info_path <- read.csv(syn_gene_file$path)
gene_info_path <- gene_info_path %>% dplyr::rename(gene_id = ensembl_gene_id, gc_content = percent_gc_content, length = gene_length)
rownames(gene_info_path) <- gene_info_path$gene_id

gene_var  <- intersect(rownames(counts), gene_info_path$gene_id)
gene_info_path2 <- gene_info_path[gene_info_path$gene_id %in% gene_var,]
rownames(gene_info_path2) <- gene_info_path2$gene_id

par(mfrow = c(5, 2))
for (grp in names(prep_groups)) {
  idx <- prep_groups[[grp]]
  
  cqn_fit <- cqn(
    counts     = counts[, idx],
    x          = gene_info_path2$gc_content,      # per-gene GC fraction
    lengths    = gene_info_path2$length,         # per-gene length
    sizeFactors = colSums(counts[, idx])
  )
  
cqnplot(cqn_fit, n = 1, xlab = "GC content", ylab = "QR fit", main=paste("CQN, stratified offset term_",grp,sep=""))
cqnplot(cqn_fit, n = 2, xlab = "Length (log2)", ylab = "QR fit", main=paste("CQN, stratified offset term_",grp,sep=""))

# CQN offset = glm.offset (combined log-scale offset)
cqn_offsets[, idx] <- cqn_fit$glm.offset 
cqn_E[, idx] <- cqn_fit$y + cqn_fit$offset 
}

```

```{r cqn function with output, eval=TRUE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
# -- 1. Incorporate into limma-voom
# ── 2. Build DGEList and attach CQN offset ────────────────────────────────────
library(limma)
invisible(synLogin(silent=TRUE))
dge_cqn <- DGEList(counts = counts)
dge_cqn <- calcNormFactors(dge_cqn, method = "none")  # skip TMM; CQN handles bias
dge_cqn$offset <- cqn_offsets
dge_cqn$E <- cqn_E

dge_cqn_df <- as.data.frame(dge_cqn)
dge_cqn_row <- rownames(dge_cqn)
#dge_cqn_df[1:5,1:5]
rownames(dge_cqn_df) <- dge_cqn_row
#dge_cqn_df[1:5,1:5]

cqn_save <- list("metadata" = md_valid_qc, "counts" = counts[!zeros, ], "dge_cqn" = dge_cqn, "dge_cqn_df" = dge_cqn_df)
output_filename <- "ROSMAP_md_counts_cqn_DLPFC_CN_PCC_FC_TC.rds"
saveRDS(cqn_save , file = output_filename)
synapse_file_object <- File(path = "ROSMAP_md_counts_cqn_DLPFC_CN_PCC_FC_TC.rds", parent = "syn75192265")
synStore(synapse_file_object)

```

**Differential expression model with all individual covariates compared with model residualized on technical variable data, all data and FDR<0.05**

Both models use dream weights from voomwithDreamWeights, offsets from CQN normalization, and tissue X sex X diagnosis contrasts (group)

_Full model:_ Final models with individual covariates, formula  ~ 0 + group + apoe4Status + age_cat + PMI + RIN + PC1_metrics + PC2_metrics + PC3_metrics + (1|final_batch) + (1|individualID)

_Residualized matrix model:_ Final models run with counts residualized on technical variables, formula  ~ 0 + group + apoe4Status + age_cat + (1|individualID)

```{r volcano-grid, fig.width=10, fig.height=10, echo=FALSE}
plot_volcano <- function(data, 
                         title = "Volcano Plot", 
                         p_cutoff = 0.05, 
                         sig_color = "#377EB8", 
                         ns_color = "grey70",
                         xlim = c(-1, 1),
                         ylim = NULL) {
  
  p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(adj.P.Val))) +
    geom_point(aes(color = adj.P.Val < p_cutoff), size = 0.8, alpha = 0.6) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = setNames(c(ns_color, sig_color), c("FALSE", "TRUE")),
      labels = c("NS", paste0("FDR < ", p_cutoff))
    ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(p_cutoff), linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
    labs(
      title = title, 
      x = "log2 Fold Change", 
      y = "-log10(FDR)",
      color = NULL
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = xlim, ylim = ylim) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11)
  
  return(p)
}

females_DLPFC6_res3_plot <- plot_volcano(data = females_DLPFC6_res3, title = "ROSMAP, DLPFC, female: Volcano plot")
males_DLPFC6_res3_plot <- plot_volcano(data = males_DLPFC6_res3, title = "ROSMAP, DLPFC, male: Volcano plot")
females_PCC6_res3_plot <- plot_volcano(data = females_PCC6_res3, title = "ROSMAP, PCC, female: Volcano plot")
males_PCC6_res3_plot <- plot_volcano(data = males_PCC6_res3, title = "ROSMAP, PCC, male: Volcano plot")
females_CN6_res3_plot <- plot_volcano(data = females_CN6_res3, title = "ROSMAP, CN, female: Volcano plot")
males_CN6_res3_plot <- plot_volcano(data = males_CN6_res3, title = "ROSMAP, CN, male: Volcano plot")
```
